import pandas as pd
import scipy.stats as stats

# Filter the dataset to include only the relevant columns
gender_degree_df = df[[gender_column, degree_completion_column]]

# Convert the gender column to a categorical variable
gender_degree_df[gender_column] = pd.Categorical(gender_degree_df[gender_column])

# Calculate descriptive statistics
descriptive_stats = gender_degree_df.groupby(gender_column)[degree_completion_column].describe()
print("Descriptive Statistics:")
print(descriptive_stats)

# Perform a t-test to compare the means of degree completion rates between genders
t_statistic, p_value = stats.ttest_ind(
    gender_degree_df[gender_degree_df[gender_column] == 1][degree_completion_column],
    gender_degree_df[gender_degree_df[gender_column] == 2][degree_completion_column]
)
print(f"T-statistic: {t_statistic}, P-value: {p_value}")
